venue.details: From the main entrance, signs will clearly direct you to the competition, in the far back of the building.

information: $20.00 registration fee. There will be no registration at the door. Competitor limit of 200. Please note that this is a different venue from last year's NovaCube. Please read the "Competitor Information" tab before registering.
